egressPolicy.description:
Egress (outbound network) policy controlling which external endpoints sandboxed
agents can reach. Includes rules with Allow/Deny/Transform/Rewrite actions.

mode.description: Rai policy mode. The enum value mapping is as below: Default = 0, Deferred=1, Blocking=2, Asynchronous_filter =3. Please use 'Asynchronous_filter' after 2025-06-01. It is the same as 'Deferred' in previous version.

action.description: The action types to apply to the content filters

severityThreshold.description: Level at which content is filtered.

source.description: Content source to apply the Content Filters.
Content source to apply the Content Filters.
Content source to apply the Content Filters.

defaultAction.description:
The default action when no user-defined rules match.
Deny blocks unmatched traffic; Allow permits it. Transform and Rewrite rules
are always applied to their matched traffic regardless of this setting —
defaultAction only governs traffic that does not match any rule.
If omitted on create, the server defaults to Deny (fail-closed). On subsequent
GET requests, the server always returns the effective value.

mode.description:
The enforcement mode for egress rules.
If omitted on create, the server defaults to Enforced. On subsequent GET
requests, the server always returns the effective mode.

rules.description:
Ordered list of egress rules. First matching rule wins.
Rules are evaluated in declaration order; the first rule whose match criteria
are satisfied determines the action taken on the request.

action.description:
The action to take when this rule matches, including the action type and any
type-specific configuration (headers for Transform, rewrite target for Rewrite).

match.description: The match criteria for this rule.

name.description: Name of the rule. Must be unique within the policy.

ruleType.description: The type of rule (e.g., Fqdn). Determines how match criteria are interpreted.

host.description:
Host pattern to match using DNS wildcard syntax (e.g., "\*.openai.com").
A leading "\*." matches any subdomain. Omit to match all hosts.

path.description:
Path pattern to match using URI prefix matching.
An asterisk serves as a single-segment wildcard.
For example, "/v1/\*" matches "/v1/chat". Omit to match all paths.

headers.description:
Header transforms to apply. Required for Transform; optional for Rewrite;
not allowed for Allow or Deny.

rewrite.description: Destination override. Required for Rewrite; not allowed otherwise.

operation.description: The operation to perform on this header.

valueRef.description: A dynamic header value resolved at request time from a secret or managed identity.

managedIdentityRef.description: Resolve the value from a managed-identity token.

secretRef.description: Resolve the value from a stored secret.

format.description: Optional format for the resolved value; "{value}" is the placeholder, e.g. "Bearer {value}".

secretId.description: Identifier of the secret to inject.

format.description: Optional format for the resolved token; "{value}" is the placeholder, e.g. "Bearer {value}".

resource.description: The resource/audience the token is requested for.

host.description: Target host. Original host is kept if omitted.

path.description: Target path (literal string). Original path (and query) is kept if omitted.

scheme.description: Target scheme. Original scheme is kept if omitted.
